module.purpose: Provides the API endpoint for creating recurring bookings, applying optional bot verification, rate limiting, session lookup, and delegation to the recurring-booking workflow.
module.summary: This module adapts a Next.js API request into the recurring booking service. It derives the caller IP, conditionally validates a Cloudflare Turnstile token based on environment configuration, enforces core rate limits, retrieves the server session, and forwards booking, platform, and email options. The endpoint returns the service-produced booking response array through both a named export and the standard responder wrapper.
module.businessContext: Supports recurring event booking in the scheduling product and protects that booking flow from abuse. Failures can block recurring reservations or weaken verification and rate-limit enforcement.
